name: handpass6-answered-roster-does-not-linger
source: hand pass 6 owner console turns 13:54:05-13:54:26 and 08:53:17-08:53:44 (contact_respond_id 437264483, 17 Sep 2026). Case 1: an answered product roster's own domain swallows the NEXT ask ('any purchase cost') as a broaden_all of itself instead of switching domain - measured pre-fix (psql chatbot.turns 13:54:05-13:54:26): 13:54:26 'hmm ok, any purchase cost' still carried has_stock=t, has_po=t and NEVER carried has_pcost. Re-pinned 17 Sep 2026 (tester 24, coder 23's R-a ruling `1a065da1c`): the brief's original precondition ('check stock srtwc286' then 'i want stock and PO only') was itself the roster-on-a-settled-carry-domain-switch behaviour R-a retires - a settled multi-code carry switching domain now runs for ALL codes, no roster, so that step could never legitimately arm a roster to answer. Swapped to a precondition that still genuinely arms a roster under R-a's own 'must narrow to one' exception: 'incoming for srtwc286' (the `incoming` domain's product narrowing is `narrow_to_code`, which asks even under R-a since it must settle to ONE code, not all ten) - confirmed live (probe run, 17 Sep 2026): 10-option stamped roster, answered by position, THEN the domain-switch-over-a-settled-single-code-carry defect this case actually tests fires cleanly. Case 2: an escalate offer's 'yes' must assign the customer_service team - db_add_comment_contains reads response->'actions' straight off chatbot.turns (no --db-url given at runner ArgumentParser level is a hard failure of the matcher itself, not a skip).
